source.title: council election register
source.method: Each record's year was read from the council's electoral change order on legislation.gov.uk, another statutory instrument, or the council's own election pages, quoted verbatim. Scottish and Welsh councils follow their statutory five-year cycle. Records marked unverified carry no year and are shown as 'Not verified'.
source.rule: Printed only where the record is verified and the quoted text contains the year.
